title: A formal proof of the Kepler conjecture (Flyspeck project, 2017)
summary: In 2017, Thomas Hales and co-authors published a peer-reviewed paper in Forum of Mathematics, Pi describing a machine-checked formal proof of the Kepler conjecture, the official published account of the completed Flyspeck project.
body: Thomas Hales and co-authors published the peer-reviewed paper 'A FORMAL PROOF OF THE KEPLER CONJECTURE' in Forum of Mathematics, Pi (Cambridge University Press, 2017; DOI 10.1017/fmp.2017.1). The paper describes what its abstract calls 'a formal proof of the Kepler conjecture on dense sphere packings in a combination of the HOL Light and Isabelle proof assistants', and states that it 'constitutes the official published account of the now completed Flyspeck project.' A preprint with the same title and abstract was posted to arXiv by Thomas Hales on 9 January 2015 (arXiv:1501.02155, math.MG and cs.LO).
